server.description: Kioku — MCP server for Obsidian vault access. Enables AI agents to search, read, write, and organize notes through the Model Context Protocol.

transports.description: Local process transport used by desktop and CLI MCP clients.
HTTP transport for long-running or shared deployments; loopback is the secure default.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault root.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_MAX_RESULTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of search results returned by query tools.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: MCP transport value: stdio or http. The http value selects Streamable HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host or interface used by the Streamable HTTP listener.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port used by the Streamable HTTP listener.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for Streamable HTTP; required for non-loopback bindings unless the unsafe override is explicitly enabled.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact browser origins accepted by Streamable HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_TRUSTED_PROXIES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated proxy IP addresses trusted to supply forwarded headers.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Unsafe override that permits a non-loopback Streamable HTTP listener without an API key.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum accepted MCP HTTP request body size in bytes.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum execution time for an MCP POST request in seconds.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_OBSIDIAN_PORT
environmentVariables.description: WebSocket port exposed by the optional Obsidian plugin bridge.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret for the Obsidian bridge WebSocket; it must match the plugin setting.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Ollama service used for embeddings and optional generation.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_EMBEDDING_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama embedding model.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_GEN_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama model for optional local generation tools; unset disables generation.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_INDEX_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent vault indexing operations.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_EMBEDDING_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent embedding requests.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_ALLOW_EXTERNAL_READS
environmentVariables.description: Allows read-only imports outside the vault only from explicitly configured roots.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_EXTERNAL_READ_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Platform-path-separator-delimited roots allowed for external read-only imports.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_ALLOW_PERMANENT_DELETE
environmentVariables.description: Enables irreversible deletion; soft delete remains available when false.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub token used by the share_as_gist tool.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_ENABLE_METRICS
environmentVariables.description: Enables in-memory tool-call counters; note contents are never recorded.

environmentVariables.name: KIOKU_SENTRY_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in Sentry DSN for crash reporting.

versioning.rootWorkspace: The private root package.json is an unversioned workspace coordinator and is not a release artifact.
versioning.server: The NuGet PackageVersion is authoritative for the server and must match both version fields in the MCP server manifest.
versioning.plugin: The Obsidian plugin lives in its own repository (sandovaldavid/kioku-obsidian) with its own release pipeline and SemVer, fully independent from server SemVer. This repository no longer tracks plugin version files.
versioning.bridge: The bridge protocol currently supports version 3 only (BridgeProtocol.MinVersion = BridgeProtocol.MaxVersion = 3 in ObsidianBridgeService.cs); the min/max range mechanism exists for a future backward-compatibility window, but none is open today. Compatibility is negotiated at connection time via the `auth` handshake, where the server sends its supported min/max version range and the plugin responds with the negotiated version and granted capabilities — not by requiring the server and plugin to share a product version number. This replaces the same-version coupling that existed when server and plugin shipped from a single repository. The canonical wire-format examples for this handshake and for runtime request/response messages live in `src/Kioku.Mcp.Server.Tests/Fixtures/BridgeProtocol/` and are covered by `BridgeProtocolFixtureTests`; the plugin repository (sandovaldavid/kioku-obsidian) keeps its own copy of the same fixtures validated by its own test suite, so a breaking wire-format change fails locally on whichever side made it, without needing a shared package or cross-repo CI.
